rejected_jobs.title: Business Analyst
rejected_jobs.full_description:
About The Company
adesso SE is a leading IT service provider renowned for its commitment to IT excellence and innovative solutions. The company specializes in delivering comprehensive IT consulting, software development, and system integration services across various industries. With a focus on fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented environment, adesso SE emphasizes continuous learning and development for its employees. The organization prides itself on its client-centric approach, ensuring tailored solutions that drive business success. By combining technical expertise with industry insight, adesso SE helps its clients navigate the digital landscape and achieve their strategic objectives. The company's culture is built on innovation, teamwork, and a shared passion for technology, making it an ideal place for professionals seeking to advance their careers in the IT sector.
About The Role
We are seeking a dedicated and talented IT professional to join our dynamic team at adesso SE. In this role, you will be instrumental in delivering high-quality IT solutions to our clients, working closely with cross-functional teams to understand client requirements and develop innovative strategies. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and a passion for continuous learning. Your responsibilities will include participating in project planning, designing and implementing software solutions, and providing ongoing support and maintenance. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on diverse projects, contribute to cutting-edge technology initiatives, and grow within a company that values innovation and professional development.
Qualifications
The ideal candidate should possess a relevant degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Proven experience in software development, system integration, or IT consulting is highly desirable. Strong knowledge of programming languages such as Java, C#, or Python, along with familiarity with modern development frameworks and tools, is essential. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, coupled with effective communication abilities, are required to succeed in this role. A proactive mindset, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement are also important qualities. Certifications in relevant technologies or methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, ITIL) will be considered a plus.
Responsibilities
Your key responsibilities will include collaborating with clients and internal teams to gather and analyze requirements, designing scalable and efficient IT solutions, and developing software or system integrations. You will be responsible for coding, testing, and deploying applications while ensuring adherence to best practices and quality standards. Providing technical support and troubleshooting issues post-implementation is vital to maintain client satisfaction. Additionally, you will participate in project planning sessions, contribute to documentation, and stay updated on emerging technologies to incorporate innovative solutions. Mentoring junior team members and sharing knowledge to foster a collaborative environment will also be part of your duties.
Benefits
adesso SE offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. This includes competitive salary packages, flexible working hours, and opportunities for remote work. Employees have access to extensive training programs, certifications, and development workshops to enhance their skills. The company promotes a healthy work-life balance and provides various wellness initiatives. Additional benefits include health insurance, retirement plans, and employee referral programs. Being part of adesso SE means joining a vibrant community that values diversity, innovation, and continuous learning, ensuring a fulfilling and rewarding career journey.
Equal Opportunity
adesso SE is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. We believe that a variety of perspectives and experiences fosters innovation and drives success. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Our hiring practices and workplace policies are designed to promote fairness and respect, ensuring that every individual has the opportunity to thrive and contribute meaningfully to our organization.

rejected_jobs.title: Data Analyst
rejected_jobs.full_description:
About The Company
RND RedaktionsNetzwerk Deutschland GmbH is a leading media organization committed to delivering high-quality journalism and innovative digital solutions. As part of the MADSACK Mediengruppe, one of Germany's largest media conglomerates, we have a rich history of shaping public discourse and fostering democratic values. Our company prides itself on its independence, impartiality, and critical perspective, which form the foundation of our journalistic integrity. We are dedicated to adapting to the evolving media landscape by integrating cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights to enhance our offerings and reach a diverse audience.
Our team is composed of passionate professionals who believe in responsible reporting and continuous innovation. We provide a dynamic work environment that encourages personal growth, accountability, and collaborative effort. With a focus on digital transformation, we are committed to utilizing data and technology to improve our services, engage our communities, and secure our position as a trusted news provider in Germany.
About The Role
We are seeking a skilled Technical Data Analyst (d/m/w) to join our team at RND RedaktionsNetzwerk Deutschland GmbH. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing our data collection and analysis infrastructure. Your expertise will enable us to better understand user behavior across more than 30 digital platforms, thereby informing strategic decisions and enhancing our content and marketing efforts. You will serve as a key technical interface between various teams, translating business needs into effective data collection and tracking solutions.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in web analytics, tracking technologies, and data management within cloud environments. This role offers the opportunity to work on innovative projects, develop technical solutions, and contribute significantly to our data-driven culture. You will be instrumental in ensuring our tracking setup is robust, performant, and aligned with industry best practices, ultimately delivering actionable insights that impact our business and editorial strategies.
Qualifications
Minimum of three years of professional experience as a Tracking-Spezialist or in a similar role within the digital media or analytics field.
Extensive experience with standard web analysis tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Firebase.
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with the ability to implement and troubleshoot tracking solutions.
Knowledge of Python or SQL, with familiarity in using Google BigQuery for data analysis.
Experience in designing and implementing tracking solutions for non-traditional sources such as CRM systems, Salesforce, and server-side events.
Excellent communication skills in German at least at C1 level, with the ability to effectively collaborate across teams.
Strong technical acumen, keeping abreast of industry trends and best practices in data analytics and tracking technologies.
Self-motivated with a proactive approach, high level of initiative, and focus on achieving goals.
Responsibilities
Own and manage the entire data collection process, from implementation to insight generation, across our digital platforms.
Serve as the primary point of contact for tracking technologies such as Google Analytics, GTM, and Firebase, ensuring their optimal use and performance.
Develop, implement, and optimize technical tracking solutions within our SST setup and Lake-House platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Maintain and troubleshoot existing tracking setups to ensure data accuracy and performance.
Translate stakeholder requirements from editorial, business, subscription, and marketing teams into technical tracking concepts and specifications.
Collaborate with external service providers, developers, and internal teams to implement and improve tracking solutions.
Provide reliable first-party data to our subscription and advertising units to support targeted marketing efforts.
Create user-friendly reports and dashboards, and work with stakeholders to derive actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
Participate actively in agile workflows, contributing to project planning and execution using tools like Jira and Kanban.
Benefits
Competitive salary package aligned with your experience and responsibilities.
Significant responsibility and autonomy in decision-making within your role.
Flexible working arrangements, including partial remote work, and 30 vacation days for a healthy work-life balance.
Job security and growth opportunities as part of the MADSACK Mediengruppe, a leading media enterprise.
Supportive team environment with regular team events, editorial meetings, and celebrations.
Comprehensive professional development through seminars, workshops, and e-learning via the MADSACK Medien Campus.
Health and wellness perks, including corporate fitness programs through Hansefit, annual health screenings, and bicycle leasing options.
On-site amenities such as a regional, seasonal canteen, free ATMs, and ample free parking.
Transport benefits with discounted public transport tickets and proximity to major transportation hubs.
Additional perks including a company pension scheme, discounted media subscriptions, and free advertising options for personal or business use.

rejected_jobs.title: Spacecraft Analyst (f/m/d)
rejected_jobs.full_description:
Description
Start Date
: February 2026
Location:
ESOC, Darmstadt, Germany
Working hours:
full time, 40h/week
Requirement
: EU Citizenship
Submission Deadline:
2026-3-20
About SSC Space
Welcome to SSC – Swedish Space Corporation, the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.
With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, space consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, flight test services, satellite propulsion systems, and much more.
SSC also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.
Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help earth benefit from space?
If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as Spacecraft Analyst (f/m/d) in our Mission Operations team and support our services in ESOC Darmstadt. We are looking for a dedicated person who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.
Security
In line with security requirements for the concerned missions of this position, the candidate has to hold a European citizenship. Evidence of eligibility will be required from candidates as part of the recruitment process. Furthermore, in view of the nature of the work the company is in, all potential employees will undergo stringent reference and identity checks.
Requirements
Degree in Computer Science or Aerospace Engineering with software content or practical experience in the relevant field
Knowledge of spacecraft control systems such as SCOS-2000
Good experience with office automation tools, including Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Access (use of functions, queries, macros, reports, input forms, etc.)
Knowledge of the Linux environment including interactive shells and shell scripting
Good experience with relation databases and correspondent management systems (RDBMS) and good knowledge of SQL
Programming knowledge and experience with Python and/or other high level programming languages, including Visual Basic and VBA for Office, are an advantage
Good communication skills and team spirit
Good knowledge of the English language
Responsibilities
Maintain the spacecraft and ground segment operational databases, related tools, procedures, and documentation under strict configuration control
Develop and maintain custom software tools that may be required for efficient and effective conduct of mission planning and preparation tasks
Support in the review of assigned documentation in the datapacks for the system level reviews, assessing the completeness and consistency of Interface Control Documents (ICDs), verifying the adequacy of the Spacecraft User Manual, including its procedures and mission timeline, as well as tests coverage and reporting
Collect the information / data regarding the performance of the mission and provision of inputs for mission reports
Support the generation of operational reports based on inputs received from other FCT members
Support for the development and integration logic for flight operations and data processing centers, services, and operational interfaces
Routine mission plan generation support, as required
Benefits
What we offer:
Thriving Environment: A growing and international environment with diverse backgrounds to learn from, with a lot of social events.
Work-Life Balance: Take advantage of our relocation support and 30 days of paid vacation.
Develop yourself: Enjoy permanent employment with diverse opportunities for growth, with our training program and a German language course.
Well being: Prioritize your well-being with access to our gym program, bike lease program, and company doctor services.
Supportive Workplace: Experience our open-door policy and ISO 9001-certified workplace, where your voice is valued and your contributions recognized
Rewards and Incentives: Receive a competitive salary, bonus scheme, deferred compensation scheme and sponsored public transportation tickets.
Our Values:
SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.
With local presence on all continents and about 750 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.
We help Earth benefit from space. Learn more at sscspace.com
📌
Please submit your application and all supporting documents in English.

rejected_jobs.title: Business Development Associate, New Grad
rejected_jobs.full_description:
About AppLovin
AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end software and AI solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.
To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.
Fortune recognizes AppLovin as one of the Best Workplaces in the Bay Area, and the company has been a Certified Great Place to Work for the last four years (2021-2024). Check out the rest of our awards HERE.
About AppLovin’s ECommerce Team
We are powering the next wave of eCommerce growth. Specializing in performance advertising, we help brands achieve profitable growth by connecting them to over 1 billion daily users across thousands of the world’s top mobile games. This scale is driven by Axon (https://axon.ai), AppLovin’s advertising platform, which enables businesses of all sizes to find their ideal customers and maximize ROI.
AppLovin’s global team combines people from different backgrounds and perspectives, united by a shared ambition to always pursue excellence and win together in a fast-moving market. We are intentional about the culture we are building and seek candidates who are outstanding in their own right while remaining deeply committed to the success of others.
Please note that this role requires onsite presence at our Berlin office.
About The Role
We are seeking a driven, analytical, and results-focused
Business Development Analyst
to join our fast-paced and expanding eCommerce team in Berlin. This is a unique opportunity to shape a new business line from the ground up and work at the intersection of performance marketing and business development within the rapidly growing eCommerce space.
In this client-facing role, you’ll partner with eCommerce brands to unlock growth by leveraging AppLovin’s marketing platform. You’ll build strong relationships with key stakeholders, help them optimize campaigns, and lead strategic initiatives that drive business outcomes. You’ll also work closely with AppLovin leadership and product experts to evolve our eCommerce advertising solution and drive adoption in the market.
Responsibilities
Onboard eCommerce brands to our platform and educate them on AppLovin’s eCommerce growth solution.
Understand what matters most to your partners and drive an action plan for their growth.
Set up new campaigns for success by leveraging best practices for creative and performance targets.
Define and analyze metrics to ensure success for our eCommerce partners.
Become an expert on AppLovin’s mobile advertising products for eCommerce brands.
Partner with the broader AppLovin Business Development team in the region.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or higher in related fields.
Self-starter and eager to learn.
Demonstrate outstanding analytical ability and strategic grasp of the “big picture”.
Have experience prioritizing competing demands.
Flexible team-player who can use drive, creativity, and initiative to move the organization forward.
Fluent in English with ability to build convincing argumentation from complex data
Demonstrated experience in handling large data sets, with a strong ability to analyze complex data and identify actionable patterns to drive strategic decision-making and optimize client outcomes.
Proven interest in technology. Whether you’re an early adopter of gadgets, or an Excel whiz, or took a computer science class in school and loved it, we are a high tech and big data company where you will constantly have the opportunity to contribute business and product ideas.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in the e-commerce space and brand operations.
A basic understanding of programming or scripting.
A basic understanding of image and video editing software.
Understanding of models for intelligent decision making, such as game theory, chess, or poker.
AppLovin has become aware of a scam targeting jobseekers with fake “app optimization” and similar roles. We do not ask our candidates to download apps or make any form of payment(s). AppLovin works with applicants through our Careers page and applovin.com email addresses. If you are contacted through other unofficial channels (such as WhatsApp or Telegram) or asked to download an app or make a payment, these contacts are not legitimate. Confirm the information here and contact us directly with any questions.
AppLovin is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or other legally protected characteristics. Learn more about EEO rights as an applicant here.
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please send us a request at accommodations@applovin.com.
AppLovin will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law. If you’re applying for a position in California, learn more here.
To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.
Please read our Global Applicant Privacy Notice to learn more about how AppLovin processes your personal information.
